title: Lightly Toasted Middle Eastern Flour Tortilla Fattoush Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful take on the classic Middle Eastern salad, featuring toasted flour tortilla crisps and a variety of juicy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing tortillas and dressing the salad

instructions: Brush both sides of flour tortillas with olive oil and sprinkle with binchotan charcoal.
Place tortillas on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly toasted and crispy.
Chop mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and cucumber into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
To toast tortilla crisps, place them in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove tortillas from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Add toasted tortilla crisps to the bowl with the mixed greens and top with crumbled feta cheese (if using).
Drizzle with olive oil and toss to combine.
